# MAPPING WITH MELANIN™
## BEAUTY SUPPLY — DEDICATED VOCABULARY

**STATUS:** Founder-approved vocabulary. Beauty supply stores need their own language, not generic retail language.  
**GATE:** Do not edit master workbook yet. Add to consolidated master update list.

**Key insight:** For many Black women, the beauty supply store visit is functional AND personal. The feedback choices must capture that reality — browsing, emergency runs, being in a bonnet and sweats without wanting to be evaluated. Separate the FEELING of the store (Vibes) from WHAT THE STORE ACTUALLY DELIVERED (What Stands Out?).

---

## BEAUTY SUPPLY — VIBES

| Vibe | What It Means |
|---|---|
| Come As You Are | Bonnet, sweats, work clothes — just come get what you need |
| Judgment-Free Beauty | No side-eye, hovering, or making you uncomfortable |
| Hair Emergency Ready | The place you think of when you need something right now |
| Quick Run Approved | Easy to get in, grab it, and go |
| Beauty Girl Playground | You came for one thing and now you're looking at everything |
| For Us, For Real | The selection actually reflects our beauty needs |
| Every Texture Welcome | Products aren't centered around one hair type |
| Protective Style Headquarters | Braids, locs, twists, wigs, crochet — the options are there |
| Natural Hair Haven | Strong selection for curls, coils, locs and natural hair care |
| Wig Girl Ready | Wigs, lace, caps, adhesive, styling tools — the whole situation |
| Braiding Day Ready | You can realistically get what you need for the entire style |
| Last-Minute Lifesaver | Saved you when somewhere else didn't have it |
| Auntie Knows What You Need | Helpful, familiar, experienced energy |
| Beauty On A Budget | Plenty of useful options without everything feeling expensive |
| Stocked & Ready | Feels dependable rather than picked-over |
| Try Something New | Enough variety to discover brands/products you haven't used |
| Neighborhood Beauty Staple | The store people have relied on for years |
| The One We Go To | The default beauty supply in the community |
| Don't Need Another Store | Broad enough selection that one stop usually does it |
| Worth The Beauty Run | Worth going out of your way for |

**"Come As You Are" is especially important** — it says something very specific to the experience without requiring a woman to explain why it matters.

**Distinction to preserve:**
- "Stocked & Ready" = a **Vibe/perception** about the store
- "They Always Have What I Need" = a **community-earned What Stands Out signal** based on repeated experiences

---

## BEAUTY SUPPLY — WHAT STANDS OUT?

| What Stands Out? | Meaning |
|---|---|
| They Always Have What I Need | Reliability |
| I Found My Brand | Carries products people specifically look for |
| My Shade Was There | Inclusive makeup/beauty selection |
| My Texture Was Covered | Products across curls, coils, locs and textures |
| Braiding Hair For Days | Strong braiding-hair selection |
| Every Color Was There | Good color selection for extensions/braiding hair |
| Good Wig Selection | Actual variety — not six wigs on a wall |
| Natural Hair Section Is Serious | Natural hair isn't an afterthought |
| Loc Products Were Stocked | Dedicated products for loc care |
| Protective Style Essentials | Everything needed for braids, twists, wigs, etc. |
| One-Stop Beauty Run | Could complete the shopping trip here |
| In & Out | Easy quick-stop experience |
| Easy To Find What I Needed | Store organization makes sense |
| Staff Actually Knew The Products | Useful product knowledge |
| They Helped Without Hovering | Assistance without surveillance |
| No Side-Eye | Comfortable shopping however you showed up |
| Didn't Follow Me Around | A particularly meaningful trust signal |
| Let Me Shop In Peace | Space to browse without pressure |
| Didn't Try To Upsell Me | Help wasn't just about spending more |
| They Put Me On | Staff introduced you to something that actually worked |
| Had The Hard-To-Find Stuff | Products other stores don't carry |
| Good Brand Variety | Multiple brands at different price points |
| Prices Made Sense | Pricing felt reasonable |
| Budget Options Were There | Didn't have to buy premium to find something useful |
| Professional Products Available | Useful to stylists as well as consumers |
| Everything Was In Stock | Strong inventory on that visit |
| Didn't Have To Hit Another Store | This is a big endorsement |
| Saved My Hair Day | They had the thing you urgently needed |
| Open When I Needed Them | Hours matched real-life needs |
| I'll Make This My Beauty Supply | Strong repeat-business signal |

## FUTURE: BEAUTY SUPPLY MICRO-SIGNALS BY SHOPPING INTENT

When a member is searching for a beauty supply, Kinfolk could eventually answer based on community intelligence organized by what the member is actually shopping for:

**BRAIDS:**
Braiding Hair For Days · Every Color Was There · Edge Control Selection · Accessories Were Stocked

**NATURAL:**
Natural Hair Section Is Serious · My Texture Was Covered · Black-Owned Brands Were There · Ingredients I Look For

**WIGS:**
Good Wig Selection · Lace Options Were There · Wig Essentials In Stock · Helped Me Find The Right One

**BEAUTY:**
My Shade Was There · Good Brand Variety · Lashes For Days · Nail Section Is Serious

**Example Kinfolk response (future):**
> Member: "I need braiding hair."
> Kinfolk: "Kinfolk consistently says this one has braiding hair, lots of colors, and usually has what they need."

That is the level of usefulness this system is building toward. A "They Always Have What I Need · 87 Kinfolk" signal is far more valuable than ⭐ 4.7.
